findings: Original SNL241 confirms all three cap stud lengths, thread-end lengths and one castle nut plus one split pin per stud assembly.
Use physical stud identities from241:013/018/023. The nested42 rows identify stud ASSEMBLIES with different survey IDs; do not label a bare rod with an assembly ID.
Per inside bracket, two MX10 and two MX36; per outside bracket, four MX9. The two inside lengths are not assigned to particular corners by the inspected schedule.

Current cap/bracket ear_x_extent34mm and stud-axis positions were unmeasured provisional controls. Printed stud lengths must constrain the axial clamp stack and receiving boss depths; do not shorten the catalogue studs to fit those placeholders.
Exact historical thread form/pitch, nut across-flats/height, nut seating plane, cotter axis and cast receiving depth remain to be established or explicitly approximated.
No new bearing washer is listed in these stud assemblies. Avoid adding hardware solely by modern convention.
